key_reasoning.reason: Router endpoint, request/response models, a new BulkMemberOverrideRunner (4 phases: check, write, recheck, rebalance), ProjectBudgetService wiring and a repository change; reuses existing private service helpers (_validate_member_amounts, _equal_amounts_with_fixed_overrides, _ensure_override_child_budget, rebalance_project_budget), so no new cross-system abstraction.

Multi-budget transactional write with an in-transaction recheck (populate_existing refresh) and one rebalance per touched budget, which reaches the LiteLLM-backed budget path; per-item partial-failure semantics (400/404 results) and ordering are subtle. A single-member override exists as precedent but does not cover batching. Authorization reuses the existing maintainer_access_only guard, so no auth change.
10 files changed (5 source, 4 test, 1 OpenAPI baseline) across src/ and tests/ in several subdirectories; 1 new source file and 1 new test file.
